Forged in fire

The samples, rebuilt in the language of your board: painted art beside real UI, ink splashes, fire and ice on navy, condensed italic type. The art here is cut from the board as a stand-in, so it is soft and small; the final pieces come from the same source at full size. Everything that moves is real.

Refined is the app's default. Expressive adds the extra sparks, the splashes and the camera.

Tier 1 · Boards 2 and 3

Ember

The forge is lit. Dynamic motion during execution, without blocking the work.

Where
Beside the running UI
How long
While the state lasts

Moments: notebook execution, pipeline execution, a cell waiting in Fabric.

The running step breathes orange; the painted fire behind the wolf breathes with it and sheds embers that rise into the UI. Frost grows slowly for work waiting in Fabric. All of it stops the moment the state ends.

Tier 2 · Boards 4 and 8

Spark

The hammer rang. Satisfying feedback when a query completes; clear, dramatic, never disruptive when it fails.

Where
At the result
How long
0.4 to 0.6 s, once

Moments: SQL execution, cell success, errors.

SELECT o.CustomerKey, o.OrderDate, SUM(o.Amount) as Total FROM dbo.FactOrders o WHERE o.OrderDate >= '2024-01-01' GROUP BY o.CustomerKey, o.OrderDate
✓Query completed
2,847 rows · 1.4 s
!Execution failed
Column 'CustomerKey' cannot be found.

Run: the result card pops with an orange ink splash behind it and sparks spray off it toward the wolf. Fail: the calm wolf gives way to the snarling one in red, the card shakes once, and the message is there from the first frame. No screen flash, nothing covered.

Tier 3 · Boards 5 and 6

Forge

The blade is finished. A powerful, satisfying moment when a deployment succeeds.

Where
The whole panel
How long
0.8 s, once

Moments: deployment, optimization results, long runs finishing.

Deploy platform to Prod

  • Validate artifacts
  • Build package
  • Deploy to Fabric
  • Updating workspace
  • Deployment complete

The steps tick through; on the last one the hammer comes down into the panel: a flash, an ink splash, sparks everywhere, and the painted strike holds as the still. In the app this is the Anvil Strike at Forge scale.

The art is placeholder cut from your board. The sequence, camera, particles, splashes and type are final-grade and take full-size art as a drop-in. Any key or click ends it at once. In the app it draws in a transparent, click-through overlay on the same monitor, off unless celebrations and "leave the window" are both on.

Type: Barlow Condensed black italic for display, as on the board; Source Sans for text. Colours: KratosBI navy #1b3664 and orange #f8991c, fire from the orange, ice from the navy, and the board's red only for failure. Art is cut from the mood board as a placeholder.
